speaker: alice
text: So Alex, Queensland's renewable rollout keeps chugging along nicely, more rooftop solar, more community batteries popping up in suburbs from Brisbane to Cairns. It's the unglamorous kind of good news, nobody's throwing a parade, but the numbers keep climbing.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah and it's not just the big flashy wind farms either, it's your neighbour with panels on the roof and a battery in the shed quietly doing their bit. Every little bit of sunshine harvested is one less coal fired kilowatt, and let's be honest, Queensland's never been short on sunshine.

speaker: alice
text: Speaking of things looking up, Reef Check volunteers have been out snorkelling around parts of the Great Barrier Reef and reporting some genuinely encouraging coral recovery. It's not mission accomplished by any stretch, but healthier patches of coral popping back to life is exactly the kind of quietly hopeful news we love bringing you.
